messages:
anya: quick sync — i pushed a PR that tightens dashboard card padding (space.030 -> space.025) and reduces grid gutter to space.040. on staging the primary CTA on cards looks vertically off and when two toasts appear they overlap the card header. screenshots in the PR: https://staging.redwood.dev/shot1.png

mike: saw the screenshots, ty. can you paste the token diff here? also does this change affect table row height in console lists?

anya: token diff snippet:
```diff
- --space-030: 12px;
- --space-060: 24px;
+ --space-030: 10px; /* now space.025 */
+ --space-040: 12px;
```
this was meant to make the card chrome more compact for dense dashboards.

lina: small tweak ok but button vertical centering looks off — likely because actions container lost `align-items: center`. quick CSS fix: `.card-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: var(--space-025); }`

sanjay: re: toasts — current implementation mounts toasts inside the root body flow and uses absolute top offsets. when cards are short the toast overlaps header. suggest using a dedicated toast portal with fixed positioning so it doesn't collapse into surrounding content. minimal idea:
```css
.toast-portal { position: fixed; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; z-index: 9000; }
.toast { transform: translateY(calc(var(--toast-height) * var(--stack-index))); }
```
this avoids header overlap.

mike: fixed bottom is fine but console has a footer action bar, and some pages have bottom drawers. can we make the portal respect a reserved footer height? maybe `bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + var(--footer-height) + 16px)`

anya: good call. also accessibility: toasts currently use `aria-live=\"polite\"` but when multiple toasts appear we get repeated announcements. proposal: keep aria-live on the portal but set `aria-atomic=\"false\"` and only announce the newest toast content, maybe by toggling a visually-hidden region with the latest message.

lina: yes — i'd also add `role=\"status\"` for the live region. and keyboard behavior: ESC today closes modals but not toasts. i'd expect ESC to clear non-persistent toasts only when focus isn't trapped in a modal. add focus checks before ESC clears.

sanjay: small perf note — using `calc` with CSS vars plus reading `offsetHeight` in JS can cause layout thrash if we reflow on every toast. prefer computing transform values in JS once on mount and applying `transform: translateY(...)` directly; that avoids extra layout reads.

mike: action items i can own tomorrow: 1) anya open a revert for the space.025 change (restore space.030 for card padding) to avoid immediate regressions; 2) sanjay implement toast portal with fixed positioning and footer-safe calc; 3) lina add aria/live/escape behavior changes and a11y test cases; 4) i'll add a QA ticket to regression test tables and card CTA alignment. target: EOD tomorrow? :thumbsup:

anya: sgtm — i'll open the revert PR now and attach staging screenshots + screenshot diff. thanks for quick feedback.

design-bot: reminder: design token change PR #3215 assigned to anya — status: needs review.

mike: once revert is merged let's re-run the token visual diffs in Percy and then re-introduce the compactness change behind a feature flag for gradual rollout.

anya: noted — i'll flag behind `experimental.denseCards` and ping here when ready for canary. thanks!"
